user.title: SolaX Adapter Box G2
user.description: Connect to the Adapter Box G2 in your local network. Only values are read; nothing is changed on the box.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the box, e.g. 192.168.1.50.
data_description.password: The registration number from SolaXCloud (device details). It is the same as the serial number and starts with SD.

error.cannot_connect: The box cannot be reached. Check the IP address and that the box is online.
error.invalid_response: The box answered, but not with data. Check the registration number.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up. Its IP address has been updated.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the box is read (5–300 seconds).

cannot_connect.message: The box cannot be reached. Home Assistant keeps trying.

invalid_response.message: The box answered, but not with data. Check the registration number.
